assumptions: W9 of PLAN-0008, the join point (depends on all seven packs W2-W8), built in-session by a single writer. The harness (.warp/pack_conformance.py) is build machinery in the repo-root .warp/ (like pack.py and tracker_conformance.py), NOT shipped engine: ENGINE_GLOBS globs plugin/templates/.warp/*.py (the 7 shipped modules), not the repo-root .warp/, so the module is not copied into packs and forces no re-assembly (engine_files == 139, the module unmatched). It reads .warp/packs.json so a new pack is covered the moment declared. The gate is driven locally with no network: each pack is extracted via git archive (mode-preserving) into a throwaway repo, committed, and its committed pre-push hook (or the guard directly, for the option-B Claude pack that ships no committed hook of its own) is invoked against a constructed unproven vs proven state; one real git-push-to-a-local-bare-remote case proves the exec bit is load-bearing end to end. This spec also closes the WARP-0808 non-blocking robustness note (the per-pack selftest blocks asserted working-tree os.access, which can diverge from the git index; W9 asserts the COMMITTED index mode via git ls-files -s). One independent adversarial review (agent aa2bcd8f) bound to 3195da6 returned pass_with_notes, 0 blocking; it verified the gate GREEN in its own isolated worktree/clone, all 5 ACs by concrete probes, and left the main repo untouched.

Accepted non-blocking review notes (not defects): (1) the proven fixture is a single-commit repo, so the guard/policy evidence-inheritance PARENT rule is not exercised by W9's own fixture (the direct-HEAD match path is); the inheritance logic lives in the guard and policy_check and is covered by other selftest blocks. (2) the Claude pack's drift is empty by construction (engine_src == pack_dir == plugin/templates, option B canonical-in-place, intended); the drift teeth are real for the 6 copied packs. (3) the harness proves whatever enforcement path a pack HAS works, but does not itself mandate that a non-Claude tool ship a committed git hook (a pack with none is driven guard-direct like Claude); that completeness belongs to each pack's own W2-W8 spec, which asserts the pack's specific wiring.
